title: Wedding Planning Export Freshness
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:checklist`), seating revisions (`event:seating`), vendor contracts (`event:vendor`), deposits (`event:deposit`), planning syncs (`event:sync`).
app: Wedding and event-planning telemetry — The Knot checklist exports, seating-chart revisions, vendor deposit schedules, and RSVP operations — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:sync source_name=* source_event_epoch=* export_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((export_epoch-source_event_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by source_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures planning export lag by data source for wedding-planning feeds.
value: Lag tracking shows which data source create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside wedding-planning feeds.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `planning export lag` on `event:sync` events and aggregate them by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of data source with average and worst planning export lag.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how long things take for each data source so you can see where wedding-planning feeds slows down.
